permissions.purpose: Creates one product, named after you, in your own Stripe account, for your subscription plans to belong to.
Creates a price for each plan you choose in your Amply editor: every 3, 6 or 12 months, at the amount you set.
Makes a Stripe Payment Link for each plan, so fans pay on Stripe's own checkout page, and switches them off if you disconnect. Fans' card details never touch Amply.
Turns on Stripe's customer portal, so fans can cancel or change their card themselves on Stripe's page, without needing to contact you.
Checks whether each fan's subscription is still active, when it's due to renew and otherwise once a day, so a fan who cancels stops getting paid music. It can't change subscriptions.
Confirms that a checkout a fan has just finished really was paid, and which fan it was, before their subscription starts. It reads nothing else.
